## Tidying

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Setting up directories for later downloads, and a timeout limit to allow the downloading of larger files.
options(timeout = 1200)
rdir <- "data/_raw"
edir <- "data/_external"

# Downloading of .csv's from Brainspan.
zip_url  <- "https://brainspan.org/api/v2/well_known_file_download/267666525"
zip_path <- file.path(rdir, "brainspan_genes.zip")


# Downloading and Unzipping Expression Matrix, while making it a prerequisite that the expression matrix and the two metadata .csv's are present.

prereq <- file.path(rdir, c("expression_matrix.csv", "columns_metadata.csv", "rows_metadata.csv"))

if (!all(file.exists(prereq))) {
  download.file(zip_url, zip_path, mode = "wb")
  download.file(zip_url, zip_path, mode = "wb")
  file.size(zip_path) / 1e6
  unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)
  unzip(zip_path, exdir = rdir)}

# Reading matrices and metadata
rows_metadata <- read_csv(file.path(rdir, "rows_metadata.csv"))
columns_metadata  <- read_csv(file.path(rdir, "columns_metadata.csv"))
  col_types = cols(.default = col_double())
expression_matrix <- read_csv(file.path(rdir, "expression_matrix.csv"),
                              col_names = c("GeneID", as.character(columns_metadata$column_num)),
                              col_types = cols(.default = col_double()))



hippocampus_expression_matrix <- read_csv(file.path(edir, "BrainSpan_HIPPOCAMPUS_expression_matrix.csv")) 
DLPFC_expression_matrix <- read_csv(file.path(edir, "BrainSpan_DLPFC_expression_matrix.csv"))
  

rows_metadata
columns_metadata
expression_matrix
hippocampus_expression_matrix
DLPFC_expression_matrix
```

```{r}
# Calling the first row of the two expression matrices, as tibbles, which are both transformed to extract their linearized values as pure vectors, which are converted to pcw, unless they're already born whereupon their unit is converted to years (yrs).

ltnc <- "(?<=plus0\\.7_)-?\\d+\\.\\d+"
hpc_colnames <- tibble(sample=names(hippocampus_expression_matrix))|> mutate(age_log = as.numeric(str_extract(sample, ltnc))) |> filter(!is.na(age_log)) |> mutate(age = round(((10^age_log-0.7)*52+40),1)) |> mutate(age = if_else(age >= 40, str_c(round((age-40)/52,1),"yrs"),str_c(age,"pcw"))) 

dlpfc_colnames <- tibble(sample=names(DLPFC_expression_matrix))|> mutate(age_log = as.numeric(str_extract(sample, ltnc))) |> filter(!is.na(age_log)) |> mutate(age = round(((10^age_log-0.7)*52+40),1)) |> mutate(age = if_else(age >= 40, str_c(round((age-40)/52,1),"yrs"),str_c(age,"pcw"))) 

# Converting the legible value tables to lists.

hpc_list <- as.list(hpc_colnames) 
dlpfc_list <- as.list(dlpfc_colnames)

# Replacing the linearized, logarithmic column values with standardized cwd/yr values.
hpc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames <- hippocampus_expression_matrix
colnames(hpc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames) <- c("gene", make.unique(as.character(hpc_list$age)))

dlpfc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames <- DLPFC_expression_matrix
colnames(dlpfc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames) <- c("gene", make.unique(as.character(dlpfc_list$age)))

dlpfc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames

```

```{r}
tidy_matrix1 <- rows_metadata |> select(ensembl_gene_id,gene_symbol,row_num)

tidy_matrix1 <- tidy_matrix1 |> cross_join(columns_metadata) |> select(ensembl_gene_id,gene_symbol,donor_id,gender,age,structure_name,row_num,column_num)

m <- as.matrix(expression_matrix[, -1])
tidy_matrix1 <- tidy_matrix1 |>
  mutate(rpkm = m[cbind(row_num, column_num)]) |> select(ensembl_gene_id,gene_symbol,donor_id,gender,age,structure_name,rpkm)

```

```{r}
sfari <- read_csv("https://gene.sfari.org//wp-content/themes/sfari-gene/utilities/download-csv.php?api-endpoint=genes") |>
  rename_with(\(x) str_replace_all(x, "-", "_")) |>
  select(ensembl_id, gene_score, syndromic) |>
  filter(!is.na(ensembl_id)) |>
  distinct(ensembl_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

tidy_matrix1 <- tidy_matrix1 |>
  left_join(sfari,
            by = join_by(ensembl_gene_id == ensembl_id),
            relationship = "many-to-one")

sfari |>
  anti_join(tidy_matrix1 |> distinct(ensembl_gene_id),
            by = join_by(ensembl_id == ensembl_gene_id))

sfari_matrix <- tidy_matrix1 |>
  filter(gene_score >= 1 | syndromic == 1) |> select(ensembl_gene_id,gene_symbol,donor_id,gender,age, structure_name,rpkm,gene_score,syndromic)

tidy_matrix1
```
